grammar.title: have got 拥 有
lines: 在某些特定的语境下，" have got " 也可以传达一种更强烈的意义。大多数情况下，"have" 和 "have got" 可以互换使用，表示拥有或具有某样东西或状态。 常见缩写
人称 肯定句 否定句 一般疑问句
三单 She has a new boyfriend. She has got a new boyfriend. She does n’t have a good friend. She has n’t got a good friend. Does she have a boyfriend? Has she got a boyfriend?
非三单 I have two sisters. I have got two sisters. I do n’t have any time. I have n’t got any time. Do you have any money? Have you got any money?

sentences.title: I must go to the... 我必须去...
lines: I must go to the GROCER'S to get some cheese、eggs、butter、honey、jam、biscuits
